title: QR self check-in
summary: Turn on the clinic QR, see what the patient fills in, and accept them into the queue.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.narration: Patient QR lives in Settings. Tap Settings in the menu.

steps.title: Turn it on
steps.narration: Turn on patient check-in by QR. Your clinic's code appears.

steps.title: Print the poster
steps.narration: Tap Print poster, and put the poster at the front desk or on the door.

steps.title: The patient scans the code
steps.narration: Now the patient's side. They scan the code with their phone and see this short form. They type their name and mobile number.

steps.title: Why they came
steps.narration: They tap what brings them in, such as Tooth pain.

steps.title: Consent
steps.narration: They tick that they agree to the clinic keeping their record.

steps.title: Please take a seat
steps.narration: The patient is asked to take a seat. Nobody is in the queue yet. Back at the desk.

steps.title: Waiting to check in
steps.narration: On the Queue, a strip shows how many patients have scanned and are waiting. Tap Review.

steps.title: Accept as a new patient
steps.narration: You see what they entered. If they are new, tap Accept. A returning patient is matched to their file.

steps.title: In the queue
steps.narration: The patient is now in the queue, and the strip is gone.
